description: Point an existing dynamic QR code that opens a website at a new destination URL. The printed code stays the same; scans go to the new address from now on (routing rules set in the dashboard still send the scans they match elsewhere). Use it when the person says the link behind a code should change (a new menu, a moved page). Codes that open a hosted page are changed in the dashboard instead. The new destination is screened like a new code's. Needs the person signed in to QRdx.

destinationUrl.description: The new destination: a full http(s) URL

id.description: The code's id, from create_dynamic_code or list_codes

name: update_code_destination
title: Change where a code goes
